name: Data.goodProjTranslate_mem_integralForms
summary: The value is a sum of translates of a·ι(z) with coefficients |𝖦|e₀(t), which are integral; the gauge of a sum is at most the maximum.

steps.claim: At each point, by iota_goodProjTranslate_apply the value of a·ι(goodProjTranslate s z) is Σ_t |𝖦|e₀(t)·a·(ι z)(g·groupLift(t·s)); the Weyl gauge of a sum is at most 1 if each term's is (weylGauge_sum_le).
steps.lean:
a • iotaAtLevel ϑ (D.goodProjTranslate s z).1 ∈ LevelForm.integralForms j := fun _ ↦ by
  erw [weylGauge_smul, iota_goodProjTranslate_apply, ← weylGauge_smul,
    Finset.smul_sum]; apply weylGauge_sum_le <;> intros; simp

steps.claim: Each term: gauge(c·y) ≤ |c|·gauge(y) with |c| ≤ 1 for the integral coefficient c = |𝖦|e₀(t) (norm_le_one_of_isIntegral), and the translate of an integral form by an element of K₀ is integral (weylGauge_mul).

The hypotheses: h; groupLift lies in K₀, hence in the local level (Kf_le_localLevel); and the coefficients |𝖦|·e₀(t) (not e₀(t) itself) are algebraic integers: g ↦ |𝖦|·e₀(g) is the character of a finite-dimensional representation of 𝖦 (IsCentralProj.isChar), and character values are algebraic integers (isCentralProj_e₀.isChar.isIntegral). Step 2 uses this scale.
